in_hebrew.name: Gassman
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Man of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gassman הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'gas', meaning 'treasurer' or 'keeper'. The name Gassman signifies a person who is a faithful steward of God's resources and blessings. In the New Testament, the name is used for a man named Gaius, who was a leader in the early Christian community and showed great hospitality to Paul.
